alo171.title: ALO 171 Quit Smoking Helpline (Türkiye)
alo171.cost: Free from landlines; calls from mobiles may be charged at your operator's rate.
offers: Assessment of your level of dependence
An appointment at a quit-smoking clinic

clinics.title: Quit-smoking clinics
clinics.text: In Türkiye, quit-smoking clinics are available in hospitals, healthy living centres and family health centres. If the doctor sees fit, quit-smoking medicines are given free of charge. ALO 171 refers you to the nearest clinic. Outside Türkiye, ask your doctor or national quitline.

yesilay.title: Yeşilay Counselling Centre (YEDAM)
yesilay.text: Yeşilay's counselling centres in Türkiye offer free psychological and social support for addictions, including tobacco. You can get an appointment by calling the 115 YEDAM Helpline.

emergency.title: In an emergency, 112
emergency.text: If you feel that you or someone else is in danger in an emergency, call 112 (or your local emergency number) right away.

supporter.intro: Send a ready-made message to your supporter. The message goes through your phone's share menu; the app never sends anything itself.

messages.label: Quit day
messages.text: Hi {supporter}, I'm quitting smoking on {date}. Can I message you when it gets hard? Your support means a lot to me.

messages.label: Progress
messages.text: I've been smoke-free for {days} days! Thank you for being with me through this, {supporter}.

messages.label: A hard moment
messages.text: {supporter}, I'm having a hard moment with a craving right now. Can we talk for a few minutes?

doctor.intro: A short summary you can use at a quit-smoking clinic or with your doctor. The summary is created on your device and only sent if you share it.
doctor.note: This summary was created from information the user entered into the app themselves; it's not a medical assessment.
